user.title: Indian BLDC Fan Setup (Optical IR)
user.description: Configure your fan brand/remote model and preferred IR transmission format. Note: This integration is strictly for optical infrared (38kHz) fans.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this fan entity (e.g. Living Room Fan).
data_description.fan_model: Select your fan brand and remote model.
data_description.ir_format: Select the IR signal format matching your hardware blaster.

emitter.title: Select IR Transmitter
emitter.description: Choose an IR Transmitter entity (infrared.* or remote.*) or configure an MQTT command topic (for Tasmota) to send optical commands to **{name}**.

data_description.mqtt_topic: MQTT command topic to dispatch Tasmota IR payloads (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_ir/IRsend).
data_description.emitter_entity_id: Entity ID of the IR blaster (infrared.* or remote.*). Optional if using an MQTT topic.
data_description.availability_entity_id: Optional smart plug, router device tracker, status sensor, or helper to monitor blaster availability.
data_description.availability_topic: Optional MQTT topic to monitor blaster availability (e.g. Tasmota LWT topic tele/tasmota_ir/LWT).

error.missing_tasmota_endpoint: Please provide either an MQTT command topic or a remote entity.
error.both_endpoints_provided: Please configure either a remote entity or an MQTT topic, not both.
error.invalid_mqtt_topic: Invalid MQTT command topic. Topic must contain '/' and cannot contain '+' or '#' wildcards.
error.invalid_availability_topic: Invalid MQTT availability topic. Topic must contain '/' and cannot contain '+' or '#' wildcards.
error.invalid_emitter_entity: A valid Home Assistant remote or infrared entity is required for this format.
error.topic_not_supported_for_format: Direct MQTT topics are only supported when IR format is set to Tasmota.

init.title: Configure Fan Options
init.description: Adjust fan brand model, transmission format, transmitter entity or MQTT command topic, optional physical remote receiver, availability monitoring, and smart switch power interlock.

data_description.fan_model: Change or adjust your fan remote model.
data_description.ir_format: Change the IR signal encoding format.
data_description.mqtt_topic: MQTT command topic to dispatch Tasmota IR payloads (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_ir/IRsend).
data_description.emitter_entity_id: Entity ID of your IR blaster or remote.
data_description.receiver_entity_id: Optional infrared/remote entity receiving physical IR remote clicks for state synchronization.
data_description.availability_entity_id: Optional smart plug, router device tracker, status sensor, or helper to monitor blaster availability.
data_description.availability_topic: Optional MQTT topic to monitor blaster availability (e.g. Tasmota LWT topic tele/tasmota_ir/LWT).
data_description.power_switch: Optional smart plug or relay controlling mains power to the fan.
data_description.boot_delay: Grace period in seconds to wait for the fan receiver MCU to boot after turning on mains power.

speed_adjust.name: Speed Adjust
speed_adjust.description: Cycles to the next speed setting or fine-tunes speed tier.

set_timer.name: Set Timer
set_timer.description: Activates a hardware sleep timer on the fan.
